# netbox_owner_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/users/ownergroup/):

> An owner group is a set of owners.

Requires NetBox v4.5.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_owner_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
  description = "test"
}
```

### Required
